subject: design/read-to-rule-v1
statement: §0 ships as **template guidance plus two existing mechanisms**: (1) the section contract lives entirely in prd-template's next version — placement before §1, four blocks with stated honest-zero forms, a hard cap, a tier rule, the ranking rule — tunable only by template PR (`design-brainstorm:read-to-rule-tech-design#D-2`); (2) amendments touch §0 exactly as they touch any unanchored prose — **wholesale section-supersede** under the amendment model's existing grammar, no sub-anchors, no fold or docgate change (`#D-2`, F-1/F-2 of the record); (3) the capture line is a **federated sign-off-surface line**: hand-recorded at each §0 gate, its pinned format citing the review-feedback ledger's entry anchors one-directionally, with graduation to ledger-native explicitly routed through that feature's own channel if the checkpoint proves the bet (`#D-1`, ALT-3).
